about: The style presets style.py offers. Each is a block for a book's lib/book.css (the player's palette and chrome) with a character look to draw the cast in, and a sample scene that shows both. tiers: the kinds of book it suits best (lesson, picture, documentary, shorts); any style can be used for any book.

styles.name: Glass
styles.mood: frosted cards in lavender light, an indigo-to-violet accent; calm and modern
styles.suits: maths, science, business, tech
styles.characters: soft gloss: rounded shapes with gradients for volume, a white shine on head and body, no outlines

styles.name: Glass Night
styles.mood: deep indigo with violet and pink glows, frosted cards that let the colour through
styles.suits: tech, space, night scenes, bold covers
styles.characters: neon line: no fills, glowing outlines in pink, blue and mint on the dark ground

styles.name: Enchanted
styles.mood: a forest at golden hour: teal shade, a shaft of warm light, fireflies, gold buttons
styles.suits: fairy tales, adventure, nature, history told as a quest
styles.characters: soft storybook 3D: radial gradients for volume, big shiny eyes, a warm golden rim light

styles.name: Paper Collage
styles.mood: a hand-made scrapbook: cream paper, card stock, gingham, polka dots, newspaper
styles.suits: young children, school stories, crafts, nature
styles.characters: paper cut-outs with a white sticker edge and a paper shadow, patterned papers for clothes

styles.name: Kawaii Sticker
styles.mood: pastel peach and mint, white sticker cards with a thick plum outline, chunky buttons
styles.suits: young readers, early maths and reading, listen-and-find
styles.characters: chibi: a huge head, sparkly eyes, a thick plum outline and a white sticker edge

styles.name: Watercolor Storybook
styles.mood: a classic picture book: cold-press paper, soft washes, sepia ink, an italic book serif
styles.suits: picture books, fairy tales, history and nature as a story
styles.characters: washes with bleeding edges (SVG turbulence) under a fine sepia line
